name: Claw Key
summary: Within the Talon Den atop Stonetalon Peak, three druidic keys open the enchanted hoard.

sections.title: Wards of the Talon Den
sections.body: High on Stonetalon Peak, night elf druids built the Talon Den as a sanctuary and a storehouse for powerful relics. They hid the treasures behind several layers of protection. Three enchanted locks seal the hoard: the Barrow Key, the Sleepers' Key, and the Claw Key. Each key lies in its own druidic cache, shaped like a torch and hidden in the winding tunnels of the barrow den.

sections.title: Breaching the Caches
sections.body: The druids kept the keys guarded and out of easy reach. Near the barrow entrance lies the Gatekeeper's Key, needed to open the cache that holds the Claw Key. The Claw Key is vital to breaking the druids' seal and claiming the riches hidden deep within the mountain.

faq.q: What is the Claw Key used for?
faq.answer: The Claw Key is one of three keys needed to unlock the Talon Den Hoard, a warded stone chest in the heart of the Talon Den on Stonetalon Peak.

faq.q: Where can the Claw Key be found?
faq.answer: The Claw Key lies in a druid cache disguised as a torch in the Talon Den tunnels on Stonetalon Peak. Opening the cache requires the Gatekeeper's Key from the den entrance.

faq.q: What other keys are needed alongside the Claw Key?
faq.answer: The Talon Den Hoard requires the Claw Key, the Barrow Key, and the Sleepers' Key, each kept in a separate cache throughout the den.

faq.q: Why did the druids hide these keys?
faq.answer: Night elf druids built the Talon Den to keep powerful relics away from prying eyes. They used keys and concealed caches to deter intruders.

angles.text: By interrogating captured night elves, the Horde can bypass the druids' ancient defenses and pillage the sacred artifacts stored atop Stonetalon Peak.
As a druid, you bear a key named for the iconic Druids of the Claw. It reflects the sacred traditions and protective wards crafted by night elf barrow dwellers.
